relTest.notes:
In the inspection Overview, a claimed item's wording is no longer cut off: the box grows to fit the whole sentence.

In the Photo column you can now add a photo to any item: one taken during the inspection (pick it from the project's photos, searching by number, room or note), or a picture from the reviewed documents - paste a screenshot, choose an image file, or cut a part out of a page. Each picture has change and remove beside it.
